title: AML and KYC Glossary | Due diligence, beneficial owners and remote identification under the AMLR
summary: Plain-language definitions of 15 AML and KYC terms under the EU AMLR, from CDD, PEPs and beneficial owners to remote identification and open banking.
body_markdown:
*AML basics, made simple. The vocabulary of customer due diligence under the EU AMLR.*


This glossary defines 15 terms used across anti-money laundering compliance, customer identity verification and related services such as open banking. Its main legal focus is the EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation (AMLR), which generally applies from 10 July 2027. Each entry gives a plain-language definition, what the term means in practice, who it applies to and its legal basis, from customer due diligence and beneficial owners to remote identification and open banking.


*Written by Aleksander Wasiak (Compliance Officer), Authologic.*


For related terms across Authologic's glossaries, see the[Digital Identity Glossary](https://authologic.com/blog/digital-identity-glossary-index) . EUDI Wallet and eIDAS 2.0 terms are defined in the 4 parts of the[EUDI Wallet & eIDAS 2.0 Glossary](https://authologic.com/blog/eudi-eidas-20-glossary-pt1) , and terms for multi-method verification in the[Identity Orchestration Glossary](https://authologic.com/blog/identity-orchestration-glossary) . This glossary sits outside the EUDI series, next to the orchestration glossary.
